name: 2fer
description: Speaking practice while you work: a mark under each message you dictate to Claude opens a card scoring six speaking habits, with a session view and a weekly trend. It leaves out pastes, links and messages that read as typed.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model 2fer starts with. Each note is one request on your plan or API bill: opus is the most careful, sonnet uses about half of that, haiku about a fortieth, and none only counts words. /2fer model changes it later.
